column1: # The model names in common code, held two-sided (tools/model_tax.py; tools/check-model-tax.sh runs it).
#   count  the code lines of that file that match the family's token (tools/model-tokens.tsv). More fails; fewer
#          fails until the row is lowered (`python3 tools/model_tax.py lower` does it). A line that names two
#   why    `baseline <fate> <count at the baseline>: <where it goes>` for a family that joined at the baseline (the
#          table was cut 2026-10-18): the debt, with the lift or table that removes it. The count may fall below
#          the baseline number and never rise above it. Fates: A arch enum or match, P program-keyed rule, D a
#          description field, S seat word, O the model's own path, T a gate's case shape, K a kernel entry named
#          after its first model, R a registry the lift turns into rows.
#          `PIN(YYYY-MM-DD) <family>: <the missing description field or program>` for a name that enters common
#          code later, or a count above a baseline: the fact the model needs that ModelSpec or its own code does
#          not carry yet. A baseline row is not added after the baseline; a model that joined after it has PIN
# Rows sorted by path, then family.
